# proxmox_sdn_zone (Data Source)

Reads one staged SDN zone from `/cluster/sdn/zones/{zone}`. Staged values overlay the running config; fields without a typed counterpart stay in `pending`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_sdn_zone" "app" {
  zone = "vz-app"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone` (String) Zone to read.

### Read-Only

- `bridge` (String)
- `dns_zone_prefix` (String)
- `id` (String) Zone identifier.
- `ipam` (String)
- `mtu` (Number)
- `nodes` (List of String)
- `pending` (Map of String)
- `reverse_dns` (String)
- `state` (String)
- `type` (String)
